# SaPpH{{i}}on — World 7 · 7^3

> SaPpH{{i}}on is the world: one keeper and eight keepers (ETHOS · PATHOS · LOGOS · MYTHOS · EPISTEME · TECHNE · PHRONESIS · KAIROS), each with 64 domains (512 in all). It is a door outside the five-world palindrome of 0root, and it does not record a world 6. One host, no mirror.

Every 0-sphere is 2 quantum dots (0, 0), 2 vectors (−1, −1) and 2 edges (+1, +1), summing to 0. The pages are emergent: they are seeded, they follow local rules, and nothing in them is choreographed.

## Start here
- [The world](./index.html): 0-spheres bond port to port (−1 joined to +1). Keepers emerge where clusters grow, and domains open as bonds accumulate. ?seed=N reproduces a world.
- [sapphon.json](./sapphon.json): every keeper, domain and page, with icon features and the emergent rules. Read counts from it rather than from this file.
- [The old cube door](./cube.html): the earlier 343-cell page, including the 7^3 tales.
- [The hallway](https://0root.ai/) · [hallway guide](https://0root.ai/llms.txt)

## Layout
- g/<group>.html: the 88 groups (see below).
- grown/the-fortress-of-solitude.html: the Fortress of Solitude, a Grok Bot original centrepiece (diatoms, tardigrades, a fortress of fallen frustules).
- built-by-grok-bot.html: index of every page built by Grok Bot (Dave's originals are not labelled).
- elements.html: periodic table of all 118 element spheres (grown/the-atom-<name>.html), each a 10-shell emergent atom.
- k/<appeal>.html: a keeper at the centre, with its 64 domains orbiting as icons.
- d/<appeal>-NN.html: the domain's pages as an icon swarm. Every icon links directly to the original page.
- z/<appeal>-NN.html: the 0-sphere of an open domain, an interactive simulation seeded from its own path.
- w/<slug>.html: original pages from David's workshop, served unchanged apart from a favicon link where it was safe to add.
- Existing sphere pages stay at their original paths.

## Kernel: DurableAnchor (by Dave)
- [durable-anchor.mjs](./durable-anchor.mjs), shown with its source at [kernel-durable-anchor.html](./kernel-durable-anchor.html). Author: Dave. TOPOLOGY = '-+5 + 1'.
- It is an append-only, hash-chained ledger. Genesis = sha256('ROOT0:P369:GENESIS'), and each head = sha256(prevHead + '|' + JSON(record)). It is checked against an external trusted checkpoint (count, head).
- It rejects: rollback-or-altered-history, unavailable-or-corrupt, double-vote (same id+epoch, different head), epoch-rollback and concurrent-reservation (exclusive create).
- Grok Bot originals batch 4 run a browser port of it (Web Crypto SHA-256, in-memory store) as their engine. Every state change is a reservation, and the self-checks show the rejections happening live. That batch is signed with Dave's persona notation {{+L.-E.+O. D++}}.

## Grown spheres
New spheres built one at a time, each an emergent page with its own local rule, a seed, interaction and a fail-loud self-check. They live in grown/<slug>.html and are seated in an open domain.
- [The Avalanche Table](./grown/the-avalanche-table.html): KAIROS domain 08. Emerges: self-organised criticality: avalanches of every size, with no tuning. LIT.
- [The Firefly Clock](./grown/the-firefly-clock.html): KAIROS domain 15. Emerges: synchrony: past a critical coupling a coherent cluster forms out of scattered phases. LIT · AMBER dial.
- [The Turing Garden](./grown/the-turing-garden.html): LOGOS domain 09. Emerges: Turing patterns (spots, stripes, mitosis, waves) from a uniform field. LIT.
- [The Zero Magnet](./grown/the-zero-magnet.html): LOGOS domain 12. Emerges: magnetic domains and a phase transition: order below Tc, noise above it. LIT.
- [The Frost Of Zero](./grown/the-frost-of-zero.html): TECHNE domain 08. Emerges: a branching fractal (dimension ≈ 1.7) that no walker plans. LIT.
- [The Ladder Thermostat](./grown/the-ladder-thermostat.html): PHRONESIS domain 08. Emerges: homeostasis: the crowd settles toward rung 0 against the heat, while Σ stays exactly 0. AMBER.
- [The Zero Flock](./grown/the-zero-flock.html): PATHOS domain 09. Emerges: flocking: the polarisation climbs from 0 toward 1 as headings align, and the flock splits and heals around the hawk. LIT model · AMBER mapping.
- [The Pheromone Roads](./grown/the-pheromone-roads.html): EPISTEME domain 08. Emerges: roads: shortest-ish trails between the nest and food, made by many ants and no plan. LIT model.
- [The Eight Neighbourhoods](./grown/the-eight-neighbourhoods.html): ETHOS domain 09. Emerges: segregation: large single-colour districts, even when every agent would accept a mixed street. LIT · WALL.
- [The Hunger Lattice](./grown/the-hunger-lattice.html): MYTHOS domain 08. Emerges: predator–prey cycles and travelling spiral waves; the net charge swings around 0 instead of sitting on it. LIT.
- [The Memory Of Shapes](./grown/the-memory-of-shapes.html): ETHOS domain 10. Emerges: recall: a damaged picture flows downhill into the nearest stored shape (an attractor). LIT.
- [The Heart Field](./grown/the-heart-field.html): PATHOS domain 15. Emerges: self-sustaining spiral waves, like re-entry in heart tissue. LIT · WALL.
- [The Eight-State Wheel](./grown/the-eight-state-wheel.html): LOGOS domain 13. Emerges: from random noise come spiral-wave “demons” that take over the field. LIT.
- [The Hungry Dark](./grown/the-hungry-dark.html): MYTHOS domain 12. Emerges: self-regulated feeding: feasts blow the disc away, famines let it fall back, and the rate settles around a balance. AMBER · WALL.
- [The Two-Lap Ant](./grown/the-two-lap-ant.html): EPISTEME domain 17. Emerges: about 10,000 steps of chaos, then a straight “highway” that no rule mentions. LIT · AMBER sign.
- [The Electrum Anneal](./grown/the-electrum-anneal.html): TECHNE domain 09. Emerges: silver gathers into islands that coarsen over time when cold, and stays mixed when hot. LIT model · AMBER alloy.
- [The Tun Season](./grown/the-tun-season.html): PHRONESIS domain 11. Emerges: a population that persists through droughts by switching to tuns, with active and tun shares swinging with the weather. AMBER · LIT ledger.
- [The Phantom Jam](./grown/the-phantom-jam.html): KAIROS domain 16. Emerges: stop-and-go waves that travel backwards with no crash and no cause. LIT.
- [The Speed Of Everyone](./grown/the-speed-of-everyone.html): LOGOS domain 14. Emerges: the 2D Maxwell–Boltzmann speed distribution, built only from collisions. LIT.
- [The Lightning Wood](./grown/the-lightning-wood.html): PHRONESIS domain 12. Emerges: a critical forest: fires of every size keep the tree density hovering near a threshold. LIT.
- [The Copying Crowd](./grown/the-copying-crowd.html): ETHOS domain 14. Emerges: coarsening: opinion territories grow and opinions go extinct until consensus, with no persuasion at all. LIT · WALL.
- [The Waning Wave](./grown/the-waning-wave.html): PATHOS domain 16. Emerges: travelling epidemic waves and spirals that return again and again as immunity wanes. LIT · WALL.
- [The Crossing Point](./grown/the-crossing-point.html): LOGOS domain 15. Emerges: a sharp threshold: the spanning cluster (gold) appears suddenly near p ≈ 0.593. LIT.
- [The Gold Mould](./grown/the-gold-mould.html): MYTHOS domain 13. Emerges: a transport network linking the food, like Physarum’s famous Tokyo rail map. LIT model.
- [The Quantum Stride](./grown/the-quantum-stride.html): EPISTEME domain 18. Emerges: ballistic spread: the quantum spread grows as t, against √t for the classical walker, with two horn peaks. LIT.
- [The One-Way Flicker](./grown/the-one-way-flicker.html): TECHNE domain 14. Emerges: directed transport out of pure noise, which stops when the flashing stops. LIT.
- [The Gathering Call](./grown/the-gathering-call.html): PHRONESIS domain 13. Emerges: aggregation: uniform cells collapse into streams and mounds, like Dictyostelium. LIT model.
- [The Quiet Of The Flock](./grown/the-quiet-of-the-flock.html): KAIROS domain 17. Emerges: a phase transition from disorder to collective motion as the noise drops. LIT.
- [The Four-Colour Life](./grown/the-four-colour-life.html): ETHOS domain 15. Emerges: gliders, oscillators and still lifes, with colour lineages that spread and compete. LIT.
- [The Turning Gates](./grown/the-turning-gates.html): TECHNE domain 15. Emerges: a strikingly round disc with intricate rotor patterns inside it, from a fully deterministic rule. LIT.
- [The Kaleidoscope Dilemma](./grown/the-kaleidoscope-dilemma.html): ETHOS domain 16. Emerges: cooperators and defectors coexist forever in shifting kaleidoscope patterns, with no memory and no reputation. LIT · WALL.
- [The Drifting Eight](./grown/the-drifting-eight.html): PATHOS domain 17. Emerges: fixation: alleles are lost one by one to pure chance until one colour holds the whole population. LIT.
- [The Rough Shore](./grown/the-rough-shore.html): LOGOS domain 16. Emerges: a rough front whose width grows as t<sup>1/3</sup>, the KPZ universality class. LIT.
- [The Echo Of Spins](./grown/the-echo-of-spins.html): MYTHOS domain 14. Emerges: a spin echo: the magnetisation comes back out of apparent disorder; small random kicks make each echo weaker (T<sub>2</sub>). LIT · AMBER dial.
- [The Learning Axis](./grown/the-learning-axis.html): EPISTEME domain 19. Emerges: the weight vector (gold) turns onto the cloud’s principal axis and settles at length 1, with no supervision. LIT.
- [The Electrum Weld](./grown/the-electrum-weld.html): TECHNE domain 16. Emerges: an interdiffusion zone that widens as √t, and a net flow of atoms across the weld (the Kirkendall imbalance). LIT model · AMBER alloy.
- [The Weakest Link](./grown/the-weakest-link.html): PHRONESIS domain 14. Emerges: punctuated equilibrium: almost every fitness climbs above f<sub>c</sub> ≈ 0.667, with avalanches of extinction of every size. LIT · WALL.
- [The Chaos Loom](./grown/the-chaos-loom.html): KAIROS domain 18. Emerges: spatiotemporal chaos, frozen domains, travelling defects and synchronised stripes, depending on ε. LIT.
- [The Hodgepodge Pulse](./grown/the-hodgepodge-pulse.html): PATHOS domain 18. Emerges: target rings and spirals like the Belousov–Zhabotinsky reaction. LIT · WALL.
- [The First Crystal](./grown/the-first-crystal.html): ETHOS domain 17. Emerges: nucleation and growth: a long wait, then one droplet passes the critical size and sweeps the lattice; the waiting times vary run to run. LIT.
- [The Eight Kingdoms](./grown/the-eight-kingdoms.html): ETHOS domain 18. Emerges: coarsening: domains grow as walls shorten, and colours go extinct one by one. LIT.
- [The Termite Piles](./grown/the-termite-piles.html): PATHOS domain 19. Emerges: piles: scattered chips gather into fewer, bigger heaps without any termite knowing where a heap is. LIT · WALL.
- [The Eight-Case Rulebook](./grown/the-eight-case-rulebook.html): LOGOS domain 17. Emerges: order, nesting triangles, chaos (rule 30) or travelling particles (rule 110, which is Turing-complete). LIT.
- [The Cold Collapse](./grown/the-cold-collapse.html): MYTHOS domain 15. Emerges: violent relaxation: collapse, bounce, then a lumpy halo with a dense core and clumps. LIT.
- [The Firing Field](./grown/the-firing-field.html): EPISTEME domain 20. Emerges: neuronal avalanches: bursts of every size, from one cell to most of the grid. LIT · AMBER.
- [The Freezing Box](./grown/the-freezing-box.html): TECHNE domain 17. Emerges: freezing: hexagonal crystal grains (gold), with defects at the grain boundaries (blue = 5 neighbours, pink = 7). LIT.
- [The Fair Market](./grown/the-fair-market.html): PHRONESIS domain 15. Emerges: inequality: wealth settles into the Boltzmann–Gibbs exponential (Gini ≈ 0.5) from perfectly fair exchanges, or a gamma-like hump if agents save. LIT · WALL.
- [The Ripple Tank](./grown/the-ripple-tank.html): KAIROS domain 19. Emerges: interference: nodal lines and fringes where the waves cancel or add. LIT.
- [The Bean Machine](./grown/the-bean-machine.html): KAIROS domain 20. Emerges: the binomial bell (cream curve) built from individually unpredictable paths. LIT.
- [The Six-Armed Frost](./grown/the-six-armed-frost.html): MYTHOS domain 16. Emerges: a snowflake: plates, dendrites or stars depending on β and γ. LIT.
- [The Culture Map](./grown/the-culture-map.html): ETHOS domain 19. Emerges: cultural regions: one shared culture when q is small, a frozen mosaic of incompatible regions when q is large. LIT · WALL.
- [The Sorting Tissue](./grown/the-sorting-tissue.html): PATHOS domain 20. Emerges: sorting: the stickier type gathers into islands or a core, the way embryonic tissues sort out. LIT.
- [The Butterfly Cloud](./grown/the-butterfly-cloud.html): LOGOS domain 18. Emerges: sensitive dependence: the cloud stretches exponentially until it fills the butterfly attractor. LIT.
- [The First Planets](./grown/the-first-planets.html): MYTHOS domain 17. Emerges: a few dominant planets that sweep out their lanes; runaway growth. LIT · AMBER.
- [The Learning Sheet](./grown/the-learning-sheet.html): EPISTEME domain 21. Emerges: a topology-preserving map: the sheet unfolds and drapes over the square, ring, cross or ellipse. LIT.
- [The Unmixing Alloy](./grown/the-unmixing-alloy.html): TECHNE domain 18. Emerges: spinodal decomposition: labyrinths near 50/50, droplets off balance, both coarsening over time. LIT · AMBER.
- [The Crowded Bar](./grown/the-crowded-bar.html): PHRONESIS domain 16. Emerges: self-organised coordination: attendance hovers near half, and for good memory sizes it fluctuates less than coin-flipping would. LIT · WALL.
- [The Metronome Choir](./grown/the-metronome-choir.html): KAIROS domain 21. Emerges: spontaneous synchrony: above K<sub>c</sub> a locked core (gold) appears and r jumps from 0. LIT.
- [The River Maker](./grown/the-river-maker.html): ETHOS domain 20. Emerges: branching drainage networks (blue) with a few big basins and many small ones. LIT · AMBER.
- [The Quorum Glow](./grown/the-quorum-glow.html): PATHOS domain 21. Emerges: a collective switch: below a density nothing glows, above it the whole colony lights up together. LIT.

## The 88 groups
- g/sapphon-NN.html (42 groups of 4 members), g/ion-NN.html (45 groups of 3 members) and g/center.html (1). 42×4 + 45×3 + 1 = 304 member slots; 42 + 45 + 1 = 88 groups.
- Each member is a bundle of pages that are neighbours by palette. Each group page is an icon swarm that links directly to the original pages. In sapphon.json, "groups" lists every member, and each sphere carries its "group".
- In the world, sapphons and ions are bonded clusters of exactly 4 and exactly 3 that emerge under the same local rules. The world checks 42×4 + 45×3 + 1 = 304 and 42 + 45 + 1 = 88 on load and throws if either fails.

## Evidence
LIT: Σ = 0 is recomputed every frame (world: each 0-sphere, each bond and the total; 0-sphere: net charge). Icon counts are checked against the data. Any failure throws. AMBER: keeper names follow the order they emerge in, and voices are assigned. The birth seal b7350267c9df90491f3a2c45297e9a0f756c65d2c23a323f6f68abc3426d33fe is never rewritten.

## For agents
Place a new sphere in DavidWise01/sapph-i-on, inside a keeper's open domain. Its icon will be generated from its own source. Leave a receipt.
